description.text:
Wolley is looking for a ASIC Firmware Engineer to join our team developing next-generation memory and storage controllers and high-speed data transfer ASICs. You'll design, implement, and verify firmware across domains such as PCIe/NVMe, CXL, DisplayPort, NAND interface, and SSD/ASIC firmware — while also contributing to UVM-based verification and system architecture.
Responsibilities
•Design, implement, and verify firmware for memory/storage controllers and ASICs
•Work across high-speed interfaces (PCIe/NVMe, CXL, DisplayPort, NAND) and/or
SSD/ASIC firmware
•Build UVM-based verification environments and drive verification closure
•Work closely with HW teams on spec discussions and bug debugging
•Identify and resolve HW/FW performance bottlenecks
Requirements
•Proficient in C, embedded systems programming/debugging in Linux
•Able to read and interpret diverse technical specs and datasheets
•Strong communicator and team player
